description: Registry of all automated scheduled tasks and cron jobs for this project

tasks.name: Data Pipeline (Monthly)
tasks.description: Automated data fetching and git commit for Census PUMS, ACS tables, BLS OES, and BEA state income data
data_sources: FRED Economic Data — Hawaii CPI, HPI, unemployment, tax collections, min wage (FRED_API_KEY required)
side_effects: Auto-commits to git if any data was updated
Sends macOS notification when new data available
manual_sources_monitored: IRS SOI ZIP Code (download from IRS)

tasks.name: DOTAX Revenue Scraper (Monthly)
tasks.description: Scrape monthly State Tax Collections and Distribution XLSX from Hawaii.gov and save to CSV
data_sources: Hawaii Department of Taxation — State Tax Collections and Distribution XLSX (https://tax.hawaii.gov/stats/a5_3txcolrpt/)
side_effects: Auto-commits to git if revenue data was updated
Logs scraping results with timestamp and row count

notes.automation_philosophy: Minimize manual work by auto-fetching data and auto-committing. User only needs to run --regenerate when ready to rebuild tax units.
notes.git_integration: Each scheduled run that finds new data creates a timestamped commit. This maintains a clear audit trail of when data was updated.
notes.monitoring: Check logs/pipeline/ after scheduled run to verify success. launchd logs available in ~/Library/Logs/ if needed.
